name: Skull Warren
summary: The Skull Warren is a dark cavern carved into the eastern face of Dreadmaul Rock within the Burning Steppes. Originally an ogre mound belonging to the Firegut clan, it has been repurposed by their Blackrock orc allies into a training ground for fel magic.

sections.title: A Seat of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Carved into the volcanic stone along the eastern terraces of Dreadmaul Rock, the Skull Warren served for generations as part of the Firegut ogres' territory. That changed after the ogres forged a pact with the Dark Horde. In exchange for Firegut brute strength, the Blackrock clan moved deep into the mound, claiming its shadowy recesses as a dedicated sanctum for the dark arts. Today, the cave echoes with incantations under the watchful eye of High Warlock Xi'lun, who instructs new generations of Blackrock warlocks to summon demonic forces and fuel the mountain's war machine.

faq.q: Where is the Skull Warren located?
faq.answer: The Skull Warren is situated on the eastern face of Dreadmaul Rock, tucked into the middle terrace of the rocky mountain in the Burning Steppes.
While Dreadmaul Rock is traditionally Firegut ogre territory, the cave itself is occupied by the Blackrock clan. It is governed and overseen by High Warlock Xi'lun.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the cave?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan uses the Skull Warren as a dedicated training ground and ritual site for its warlocks, honing their fel magic and demonic summoning under High Warlock Xi'lun.

angles.text: The cavern demonstrates how the Blackrock clan harnesses demonic power outside the Legion's direct command, turning raw fel magic into an organized weapon for the Dark Horde.
The dark rites conducted within the Warren pose an escalating threat to Alliance outposts in the Redridge Mountains and beyond, proving the Blackrock menace commands magic as readily as brute force.
